Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. limits.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（DG-L4 标记不适用），全部结论基于静态精读与语义审查；宿主兼容版本 0.1.0-rc.6 未实测，市场兼容性标记 untested。机械预扫 29 条命中逐条裁决、全部良性排除：DG-R3-55（13 处）为测试代码与资格脚本引入的官方子进程模块及进程超时清理夹具（tests/ 各 spec 第 2-3 行、tests/qualification.spec.ts:27-28、scripts/qualify-release.mjs:3、11、620），插件运行半区无任何进程启动；DG-R3-51（5 处）为可执行 YAML 标签，仅出现在测试夹具与资格脚本拼接的临时配置字符串中，读取环境变量以提供测试根路径与审批策略（tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/cordis.yml:18、33，tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/web-ui-all.cordis.yml:36、51，scripts/qualify-release.mjs:812），随包发布的 cordis.patch.yml 与 presets/ 均无该写法；DG-R4-55（2 处）为测试后端注册的确定性模型适配器（scripts/qualification-web-backend.mjs:157、tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/snapshot-backend.mjs:478），仅向本地日志文件追加测试记录，无网络外发，不随发布物分发；DG-R3-53（4 处）均为 docs/official-dsh-plugin-installation.md:11、33、55、56 中对宿主动态插件工具的文档性描述，非代码调用；DG-R3-57（1 处）为浏览器端键盘监听（src/client/context-view.tsx:69），仅实现抽屉 Esc 关闭与焦点圈定，非按键记录；DG-R3-60（3 处）为超长行启发信号（presets/ai-novel-writer/agent.cordis.yml:9、tests/snapshots/complete-chapter.expected.json:9、tests/snapshots/workbench-browser-v1.expected.json:18），内容为提示词与测试快照的正常长文本，非混淆代码；DG-R2-57（1 处）为仓库指令文件 AGENTS.md:1，内容为面向开发代理的工程门禁指引（指向 docs/v2-development-gates.md），经语义审查无注入措辞。
limits.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (DG-L4 marked not applicable); all conclusions are based on static close reading and semantic review; the host-compatible version 0.1.0-rc.6 was not tested, and the marketplace compatibility flag is untested. The 29 mechanical pre-scan hits were adjudicated one by one and all excluded as benign: DG-R3-55 (13 occurrences) is the official child process module imported by test code and the qualification script plus process-timeout cleanup fixtures (lines 2-3 of each spec under tests/, tests/qualification.spec.ts:27-28, scripts/qualify-release.mjs:3, 11, 620); the plugin's runtime half contains no process spawning at all. DG-R3-51 (5 occurrences) is executable YAML tags, appearing only in temporary config strings assembled by test fixtures and the qualification script, which read environment variables to supply the test root path and approval policy (tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/cordis.yml:18, 33; tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/web-ui-all.cordis.yml:36, 51; scripts/qualify-release.mjs:812); the shipped cordis.patch.yml and presets/ contain none of this syntax. DG-R4-55 (2 occurrences) is deterministic model adapters registered by test backends (scripts/qualification-web-backend.mjs:157, tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/snapshot-backend.mjs:478), which only append test records to local log files, have no network exfiltration, and are not distributed with the release artifact. DG-R3-53 (4 occurrences) are all documentary descriptions of the host's dynamic plugin tools in docs/official-dsh-plugin-installation.md:11, 33, 55, 56, not code calls. DG-R3-57 (1 occurrence) is the browser-side keyboard listener (src/client/context-view.tsx:69), which only implements drawer Esc close and focus containment, not keylogging. DG-R3-60 (3 occurrences) are long-line heuristic signals (presets/ai-novel-writer/agent.cordis.yml:9, tests/snapshots/complete-chapter.expected.json:9, tests/snapshots/workbench-browser-v1.expected.json:18); the content is normal long text of prompts and test snapshots, not obfuscated code. DG-R2-57 (1 occurrence) is the repository instruction file AGENTS.md:1, whose content is engineering gate guidance for development agents (pointing to docs/v2-development-gates.md); semantic review found no injection wording.
